authorization: User authorized ISIC only, three sealed heads, complete old S and new S scoring, reused query results, frozen protocol, all classwise signs and costs publicly delivered. No fit, tuning or E.
coordinate: Same q356 frozen AugReg ViT and untrained seeded adapter pools; 1536D float64 cached features through q383 zero residual adapter and identical unit normalization.
primary: For C_H -> C_F, test whether full support has delta_correct(class3)>0 AND delta_correct(class4)<0. Report exact signs and counts, including ties/zero. This is a descriptive training-domain sign test, not a significance test or model gate.
secondary: Compare R_F -> C_F class3/class4 support and query changes; report all 6 classes, all/old/new groups and all positive, negative and zero changes. Classes0/2 retained as additional well-populated query checks; classes1/5 never dropped.
access: Read only ISIC S_old/S_new features, three frozen heads, delivery receipts and previously delivered ISIC aggregate query result. No raw Qfit/Qgate, HK data, H, moments, teacher, E/test or original images.
boundary: Full S is a shared scoring domain, not a common training set: C_H fitted H plus new S; C_F and R_F fitted complete old/new support. All three fitted current new S. Only within-domain predictions are paired; support-query differences are descriptive, not samplewise pairs.
interpretation: Support matching query sign supports current-recipe support-domain tradeoff, not irreducible representation limits. Lack of support sign match rejects that exact sign hypothesis, not all margin mechanisms. Query-only harm motivates generalization explanations; support failure cannot distinguish objective/regularization/linear family/representation. No selected model.
tail_accounting: Per class contribution to original overall BA delta = delta_recall/6; keep original 6-class denominator. Do not remove tiny classes or redefine success. Primary mechanism uses class3/class4 paired outcomes, not macro BA sign.
stop: Publish all outcomes and costs then stop; no follow-on experiment or monitoring.
